# Automatic module needs to be packaged as JAR

Automatic modules need to be packaged as a JAR file and cannot be loaded from a
directory. This example shows how trying to load an automatic module from a
directory will not work.

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. Compile the application and copy the resources

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the classes were created

   ```shell
   tree --dirsfirst --sort=name './target/automatic'
   ```

   Classes together with the `META-INF/MANIFEST.MF`

   ```
   ./target/automatic
   └── demo
       ├── demo
       │   └── Main.class
       └── META-INF
           └── MANIFEST.MF

   4 directories, 2 files
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR file was created

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR file

   ```
   ./target/libs
   └── automatic-module-needs-to-be-packaged-as-jar.jar

   1 directory, 1 file
   ```

3. Run the application

   First run the application using the `--class-path`

   ```shell
   java --class-path './target/automatic/demo' demo.Main
   ```

   The application works and prints

   ```
   Automatic module needs to be packaged as JAR
   Using Java 25.0.4.1
   ```

   Try running the application using the `--module-path`

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/automatic' --module demo
   ```

   The JAR file is loaded as an unnamed module and the automatic module name
   ignored.

   ```
   Error occurred during initialization of boot layer
   java.lang.module.FindException: Module demo not found
   ```

   Try with a different path

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/automatic/demo' --module demo
   ```

   Same as before. The JAR file is loaded as an unnamed module and the automatic
   module name ignored.

   ```
   Error occurred during initialization of boot layer
   java.lang.module.FindException: Module demo not found
   ```

   **Automatic modules needs to be packaged in a JAR file**.

6. Describe the JAR file

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/automatic-module-needs-to-be-packaged-as-jar.jar'
   ```

   The module description

   ```
   No module descriptor found. Derived automatic module.

   demo automatic
   requires java.base mandated
   contains demo
   main-class demo.Main
   ```

   The automatic module name is the name that we defined in the
   `maven-jar-plugin` plugin within the `pom.xml` file.

   ```xml
   <plugin>
       <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
       <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
       <version>${maven-jar-plugin.version}</version>
       <configuration>
           <outputDirectory>${project.build.directory}/libs</outputDirectory>
           <archive>
               <manifest>
                   <mainClass>${project.mainClass}</mainClass>
               </manifest>
               <manifestEntries>
                   <Automatic-Module-Name>demo</Automatic-Module-Name>
               </manifestEntries>
           </archive>
       </configuration>
   </plugin>
   ```

   The `Automatic-Module-Name` is defined in the `META-INF/MANIFEST.MF` file
   that was created by maven.

   ```shell
   unzip -p './target/libs/automatic-module-needs-to-be-packaged-as-jar.jar' 'META-INF/MANIFEST.MF'
   ```

   The module description

   ```
   Manifest-Version: 1.0
   Created-By: Maven JAR Plugin 3.5.1
   Java-Version: 25
   Build-Jdk-Spec: 25
   Main-Class: demo.Main
   Automatic-Module-Name: demo
   ```

7. Run the application

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/libs' --module demo
   ```

   This will work and will print

   ```
   Automatic module needs to be packaged as JAR
   Using Java 25.0.4.1
   ```
